observed_facts: The Candidate contract reserves reversible scoped-trial selection to the exact pre-application Candidate evaluator and forbids activation from the proposal itself.
prompts/candidate_evaluate.md defines the pre-application evaluator decision surface, including TRIAL_CANDIDATE; it does not itself grant Candidate promotion authority.

src/continual/trial_integration.py wraps ModelClient.call with guarded_model_call and binds TRIAL_CANDIDATE to the persistent bounded trial ledger; deterministic candidate regression is a separate local gate.

src/continual/openai_client.py requires the OpenAI package and, for live ModelClient construction, either OPENAI_API_KEY or GITHUB_TOKEN; without one it raises a runtime error. The live call therefore depends on an external model provider credential/runtime.

SYSTEM_DESIGN.md states that live model execution uses the OpenAI Responses API through an adapter and that CI uses reference adapters only; a manually dispatched bounded live campaign can use OPENAI_API_KEY when configured as a repository secret.

No inspected contract requires a human to manually choose the trial, and merely invoking the evaluator does not require mutating frozen requests, accepted responses, journals, active prompts, or validators.

However, the exact pre-application evaluator is not a purely repository-read/deterministic Chat-native function: it requires live model execution before the candidate can receive a TRIAL_CANDIDATE reservation.
